Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing for cougar control pilot programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a pilot program for cougar control; creating newsections; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that cougars havebecome a serious threat to the safety of citizens and their property inmany areas of the state since passage of an initiative prohibitingcougar hunting with dogs. Based on incidents that have been reportedto local law enforcement, this threat appears to be most serious inFerry, Okanogan, and Stevens counties. It is the intent of the legislature to establish a threeyear pilotprogram administered by county government to allow for limited houndhunting during certain times of each year as a means to better controlthe cougar population.

(1) The county commissioners of any threecontiguous counties east of the crest of the Cascade mountains andsharing a border with another nation but not with another state mayestablish a threeyear pilot program to control the cougar population p. 1 SB 6118in the participating counties. The pilot program's primary goal is tomaintain cougar populations at a level that provides for the safety ofthe public. (2) Beginning September 2004, the pilot program allows for pursuitand release with hounds from September 1st to November 30th and forpursuit and take with hounds from December 1st to February 28th. (3) In order to carry out the pilot program, the department of fishand wildlife must provide the county commissioners with any datarequested to design and implement the pilot program. The countycommissioners must keep the fish and wildlife commission informed ofthe activities undertaken in furtherance of the pilot program.
Washington State University shall monitorany pilot program entered into under section 2 of this act and providea report to the appropriate committees of the legislature by July 1,2007.

The sum of twenty thousand dollars, or asmuch thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal yearending June 30, 2005, from the general fund to Washington StateUniversity for the purposes of section 3 of this act.
